deviations.what: sap.uxap.ObjectPageSubSection.showTitle (showTitle='false' on the 'Order Details' and 'Products' subsections) exists only since UI5 1.77 - kept 1:1 (fidelity wins), so the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.77 to render it. Also kept 1:1: the sap.m.Avatar control (since 1.73) with its displayShape (Square) and displaySize (L) properties, used in the snapped heading and header content.

The two robot.png avatar assets use the sample's relative './test-resources/sap/uxap/images/robot.png' path; rewritten to the absolute sdk.openui5.org host ('https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/sap/uxap/images/robot.png') per the offline asset-URL rule. Same asset, literal src value only - structural-diff compares literal attribute names, not values.
